pa-482T.title: Plate: short, white with turquoise top strip
pa-482T.summary: Short plates, usually white with a turquoise strip across the top (rarely another colour). Front plates are not required, so many cars show none at the front.

pa-4bdQ.title: Landscape: green tropical, tall grass, palms
pa-4bdQ.summary: Around Colón and the capital: green tropical land with palms and very tall grass.

pa-6mS6.title: Landscape: volcanic rocks and rock walls
pa-6mS6.summary: North of David, volcanic rocks lie scattered or are built into rock walls.

pa-7icB.title: Coverage: sunset light, small southern road
pa-7icB.summary: Sunset coverage appears in the south on a small road south of Tonosí.

pa-997w.title: Landscape: tropical hills, palms, dry fields
pa-997w.summary: A tropical country with lots of hills, many palms and tropical plants, plus drier rolling hills and fields.

pa-9CVX.title: Coverage: gaps on north coast and east
pa-9CVX.summary: Coverage is good overall, but there is hardly any on the north coast or east of the capital.

pa-Bk95.title: Landscape: very high road, dry mountains
pa-Bk95.summary: The main covered road in the Ngäbe-Buglé area is very high, almost above the clouds, with dry mountains around and big views.

pa-C9an.title: Pole: horizontal plates in the west
pa-C9an.summary: Many poles in the western provinces have horizontal plates. If an eastern vertical plate is also there, the eastern one wins.

pa-HZUB.title: Houses: warehouses and rundown blocks
pa-HZUB.summary: Colón has many warehouses and rundown multi-storey buildings.

pa-J34A.title: Pole: round concrete pole
pa-J34A.summary: Many pole types, but round concrete poles with a varying number of insulators are most common. Wooden and metal ones exist. Plates with blue, white or red painted numbers are often attached.

pa-KRgS.title: Phone numbers: first digit shows the region
pa-KRgS.summary: The first digit of a 7-digit number points to a region, and smaller-font two-digit codes help too. Numbers starting with 5, 6 or 8 are useless.

pa-Pimr.title: Houses: painted concrete, red roofs, barred windows
pa-Pimr.summary: Colourful painted concrete (sometimes brick) houses with red metal sheet or tile roofs, some ornate detail, and security bars on many windows.

pa-UMd1.title: Road: fresh tarmac, orange soil beside it
pa-UMd1.summary: Most of Road 407 has freshly paved tarmac with visibly orange soil at the sides. The south is hilly, before the road quality drops.

pa-Wv4p.title: Landscape: flat farmland, brown-orange soil
pa-Wv4p.summary: Around Aguadulce, fairly flat with lots of crop fields and very brown or orange soil.

pa-aiCk.title: Landscape: green hills, cloudy all along
pa-aiCk.summary: The road to Changuinola runs through lush green hills with cloudy or overcast skies the whole way.

pa-eSUE.title: Landscape: very flat, open fields
pa-eSUE.summary: Around David, the land is very flat with open fields, and mountains are usually visible to the north and northeast.

pa-i550.title: Pole: yellow pole socks
pa-i550.summary: Yellow sleeves around poles are found near the Panama Canal, around Gatún.

pa-iKNs.title: Road lines: white edge lines, yellow centre
pa-iKNs.summary: Many styles, but most common is a solid white edge line with a yellow centre line, which is not unique. Solid white edge lines with no centre line are almost unique to it within Latin America.

pa-kOxw.title: Pole: tall vertical plate, black zip ties
pa-kOxw.summary: In the eastern provinces, poles often carry tall yellow or white vertical plates held by black zip ties. Don't confuse them with slightly wider white plates on metal zip ties, which always have 6 digits.

pa-l8aV.title: Plate: first digit of taxi or bus plate
pa-l8aV.summary: The first digit of taxi and bus plates points to a region. Cars travel, so it is unreliable, especially outside cities.

pa-ofuG.title: Sign: stop sign says ALTO, thick font
pa-ofuG.summary: Stop signs say ALTO in a thick font. Mexico, Costa Rica and Guatemala also say ALTO but with thinner letters.

differs.how: Costa Rican ALTO letters are thinner

pa-osKk.title: Fence: living tree posts, wooden posts
pa-osKk.summary: Most roads have fences that are partly or fully made from small living trees. The remaining posts are almost always wood.

pa-pBEJ.title: Google car: big white pickup, fully blurred
pa-pBEJ.summary: A large white pickup truck, usually blurred out completely, with an antenna sometimes visible. Costa Rica's truck is usually not blurred; Ecuador's car has no antenna and no white metal railing.

differs.how: Costa Rican truck is usually unblurred
Ecuadorian car has no antenna or white railing

pa-pi72.title: Pole: thin yellow plate, black border
pa-pi72.summary: Thin yellow plates, vertical or horizontal, with a visible black border, are most common in Colón Province.

pa-rBEB.title: Landscape: pines, volcanic rock, dry grass
pa-rBEB.summary: Northeast of Volcán: mountains with pine trees, volcanic rocks, dry grass and gravel roads.

pa-raPg.title: Taxi: yellow with chequerboard stripe
pa-raPg.summary: Yellow taxis with a chequerboard stripe along the side are common. The plate is painted on the side with the city name and a regional code.

pa-t5yy.title: Landscape: wind turbines
pa-t5yy.summary: Wind turbines can be seen south and north of Penonomé.

pa-tJB0.title: Road: grainy divided concrete highway
pa-tJB0.summary: Highway 9 from the capital north to Colón is a divided concrete road that looks grainy with many tar lines. The landscape is lush and hilly.

pa-uzMg.title: Plants: banana plantations
pa-uzMg.summary: The area around Changuinola is full of banana plantations.

pa-yg2P.title: Sign: red octagon with a realistic eye
pa-yg2P.summary: Red octagonal signs showing an oddly realistic eye. Unique here.

pa-zgQt.title: Houses: many white high-rises
pa-zgQt.summary: The capital has a large number of white high-rise buildings.
